_note: The `station` field below uses PLACEHOLDER names that do NOT match assets/text/radio.json. They must be remapped onto the six real stations (CFOU-FM 104.7 modern rock, CHLL-FM 99.9 classic rock, CKUQ-FM 89.1 campus, CFRL-FM 101.3 country, CJRC-AM 1150 talk/sports, CKOT-FM 92.3 the weak English Ottawa signal) by matching format, not by frequency. Suggested mapping: ENERGIE->CFOU, ROCKDETENTE->CHLL, CKOI->CJRC (its lines are mostly traffic and advisories), CHEZ and HOT->CKOT (both English; merge and drop duplicates). CFRL (country) and CKUQ (campus) have no lines here and need a handful written in their own voice.

contextual.line: Avis d'Environnement Canada : un gros front d'orages traverse le Pontiac pis s'en vient drette sur Aylmer avec des risques de grêle!
Un arbre vient de tomber sur des fils près du club de golf sur Chemin d'Aylmer, circulation au ralenti!
Avis aux conducteurs : plusieurs feux de circulation clignotent au rouge suite à des pannes de courant dans Hull!
C'est la canicule officielle dans l'Outaouais! 34 degrés à l'ombre, humidex à 42... l'air climatisé ou la rivière, choisis!
L'asphalte est tellement mou qu'on cale dedans aux feux de circulation sur Saint-Joseph!
Oubliez pas vos animaux dans les autos stationnées aux Galeries, y fait plus de cinquante degrés là-dedans!
Deux heures du matin... pour tous les noctambules qui croisent sur Alexandre-Taché avec les vitres baissées.
Trois heures du matin... salut aux gars de livraison de journaux pis aux nettoyeurs de nuit de l'hôpital.
Pour tous ceux qui font le tour de ville sans but précis parce qu'y fait trop chaud pour dormir : salut la gang.
Dernière semaine d'août... rangez vos maillots, la rentrée s'en vient ben trop vite.
C'est le dernier week-end pour louer un pédalo à la marina d'Aylmer avant que l'automne s'installe.
Dernier vendredi soir avant le grand départ pour le Cégep... faites du bruit sur les boulevards!
Si le son griche... c'est normal... les piliers en béton du pont... coupent le signal... tenez bon...
On perd un peu la fréquence... en descendant la côte vers la marina... ajustez votre antenne...
Si la toune coupe... donnez une claque su' l'dash... ça replace l'antenne télescopique!
Le ciel est noir comme de l'encre au-dessus du pont Champlain, ralentissez, y'a déjà de l'aquaplanage signalé!
Les essuie-glaces fournissent même plus sur le boulevard des Allumettières, allumez vos phares!
La visibilité est presque nulle le long du boulevard Lucerne, gardez vos distances.
Alerte de smog et d'ozone sur la région... évitez les gros efforts pis hydratez-vous comme du monde.
Record de consommation d'électricité battu avec tous les climatiseurs des tours de Place du Portage.
Vente record de sacs de glace pis de Mister Freeze dans tous les dépanneurs entre Aylmer pis Gatineau.
Ligne ouverte de nuit : quel est le pire char usagé que vous avez déjà acheté su' la rue Saint-Joseph?
Pas un chat sur le pont des Chaudières ce soir, juste la brume des chutes pis notre musique.
Le dernier ponton est rentré à la marina d'Aylmer, la nuit est à vous.
L'odeur des feuilles commence déjà à flotter le matin sur le chemin d'Aylmer... profitez des dernières terrasses.
Les étalages de cahiers Canada pis de crayons à mine ont envahi les Galeries d'Aylmer... c'est la fin des vacances.
L'été 2004 tire à sa fin, mais les souvenirs de plage pis de cruising vont rester gravés.
Pour nos auditeurs... de l'autre côté de la rivière... on s'excuse pour les parasites d'antenne...
Le signal rebondit... sur les falaises... on revient en force dans deux secondes...
Vous entendez juste du blanc? C'est l'effet de la falaise... roulez cinquante pieds de plus!
Signal brouillé par les tours de bureaux de Place du Portage... on reprend la ligne immédiatement.
Des coups de tonnerre grondent sur les collines de la Gatineau; un bon moment pour rester au chaud.
Le vent fait tourbillonner les feuilles sur la rue Principale alors que les premiers éclairs déchirent le ciel.
La pluie d'été lave la poussière des rues d'Aylmer... roulez prudemment sur les routes secondaires.
Un après-midi caniculaire sur les plages de l'Outaouais... on prend ça en douceur.
Les parcs ombragés autour de l'Auberge Symmes sont le meilleur refuge pour échapper à cette lourdeur.
La brise du large peine à rafraîchir les rives de la rivière des Outaouais aujourd'hui.
La nuit vous appartient... musique douce pour bercer vos trajets le long de la rivière.
La lune se reflète sur les eaux calmes du lac Leamy... merci de passer votre nuit avec nous.
Le calme règne sur les collines alors que la nuit enveloppe la vallée.
Août qui tire sa révérence... le soleil se couche un peu plus tôt ce soir sur le brise-lames d'Aylmer.
Un doux parfum de nostalgie flotte sur la région en ces derniers jours ensoleillés.
C'est avec un brin de mélancolie qu'on dit au revoir aux longues soirées chaudes.
Un léger souffle sur les ondes... alors que vous traversez les zones boisées...
Le relief de la vallée fait danser les fréquences... nous restons avec vous malgré les grésillements...
La transmission faiblit au creux de la baie... nous serons de retour en pleine clarté sur la colline.
Heavy downpour hitting the Ottawa Valley right now — watch for standing water along the parkway.
Major thunderstorm rolling straight down the Ottawa River valley — batten down your boat covers at the marina.
That thunder just rattled the studio windows! Stay safe on the roads tonight.
The rain is coming down so hard you can't hear your own radio. Crank it.
Total scorcher out there, folks — thirty-six degrees and climbing. Crank the classic rock and stay hydrated.
If your engine's running hot on the bridge, kill the A/C and roll those windows down.
Hot asphalt, cold drinks, and classic rock. Surviving another humid capital summer.
Sweating through your shirt five seconds after stepping outside. Yep, that's July here.
Midnight rock marathon — rolling through the dark river roads with uninterrupted guitar solos.
Cruising the quiet capital streets after two in the morning. We're keeping you awake at the wheel.
To the driver in the white pickup idling outside the drive-thru: we see you. Here's your track.
If you're still awake at three thirty, you're either on night shift or up to no good. We love it either way.
Late August vibes across the valley. Summer's winding down, but the rock doesn't stop.
Packing up the cottage gear on the river. Late August always hits right in the nostalgia.
End of August brings that cooler evening breeze off the water. Summer 2004 was one for the books.
Static creeping in — if you're crossing the truss bridges, keep that dial locked right here...
Fading in and out across the riverbank... don't touch that tuning knob...
Whoops — losing you in the valley under the bridge. We'll be loud and clear when you hit the crest.
Cracking through the static — shout out to our Quebec listeners hanging onto the edge of the range.
River interference cutting in. Stay tuned as you climb toward Chemin Pink...

tapes.label: SUMMER 2004 CRUIZIN (DONT TOUCH)
tapes.handwriting: Aggressive black Sharpie with an underlined threat in red ballpoint.
tapes.story: Two tracks cut off at the forty-five second mark because the dial-up connection dropped mid-download.

tapes.label: ~~ Pour Marie-Eve <3 ~~ (EFFACE PAS)
tapes.handwriting: Round bubble letters with small hearts, hastily scribbled over in angry blue pen.
tapes.story: Made for a girl from Symmes who started going out with a guy with a lowered Civic two days later.

tapes.label: BASS TEST // TRUCK SPEAKERS ONLY
tapes.handwriting: All-caps block lettering with a jagged lightning bolt on the spine.
tapes.story: Rattles the Ranger's door panels hard enough to walk the mirrors out of adjustment.

tapes.label: SKATE PUNK 3 (COPIE DE STEVE)
tapes.handwriting: Tiny cramped left-handed cursive squeezed onto the paper spine.
tapes.story: A third-generation dub of a tape that was itself recorded off a boombox.

tapes.label: ROAD TRIP MONTREAL JUILL. 04
tapes.handwriting: Faded blue ballpoint written in a moving car — the letters spike where it hit bumps.
tapes.story: For a weekend drive that got cancelled when the alternator died near Masson.

tapes.label: PUNK ROCK / ~~CHANSONS TRISTES~~ / PARTY MIX
tapes.handwriting: The title scratched out three times in three different pens.
tapes.story: Ninety minutes that lurch from teenage angst to eurodance with no gap between.

tapes.label: CASSETTE A SAYYAD - RENDRE D'ICI VENDREDI
tapes.handwriting: Neat tall capitals with a stern underline.
tapes.story: Borrowed in June on a firm three-day promise. Still in the glove box in August.

tapes.label: RADIO HITS JUIN 04 (AVEC LES PUBS)
tapes.handwriting: Messy hand on a plain white sticker, smudged with grease.
tapes.story: Taped live off the FM dial with the pause button. Includes half a car dealership ad and the DJ talking over the intro.

tapes.label: NIGHT DRIVES
tapes.handwriting: Pretentious cursive in fine-point gel pen that bled onto the plastic.
tapes.story: Strictly for driving alone past the farm fields on Chemin Pink after midnight.

tapes.label: POUR LE GYM // MOTIVATION MAX
tapes.handwriting: Bold ballpoint pressed hard enough to indent the J-card.
tapes.story: Meant for a basement full of rusty weights. Actually listened to while eating fries in the truck.

tapes.label: BEACH DAY PARC DES CÈDRES
tapes.handwriting: Carefree slanted printing with a sun drawn in yellow highlighter.
tapes.story: Left on the dashboard in thirty-five degrees until the case warped into a curve.

tapes.label: HEAVY SHIT 2004
tapes.handwriting: Gothic metal lettering that took fifteen minutes to draw during a boring class.
tapes.story: Makes your grandmother cross herself when you start the truck.

tapes.label: MIX DE CHAR #4 (LE RESTE EST SCRAP)
tapes.handwriting: Frustrated heavy black pen with exclamation marks.
tapes.story: The fourth attempt after three blank discs died with buffer underrun errors.

tapes.label: RAP QUEB + US (UNCENSORED)
tapes.handwriting: Loose graffiti-style lettering with a hand-drawn Parental Advisory in the corner.
tapes.story: Loud compression artifacts and somebody's ICQ notification accidentally recorded into track four.

tapes.label: POUR QUAND Y MOUILLE
tapes.handwriting: Faint pencil that has started smudging into grey dust.
tapes.story: Reserved strictly for driving with the wipers squeaking through a summer downpour.

tapes.label: GUITARE ACOUSTIQUE // CAMPING 2004
tapes.handwriting: Neat rounded handwriting borrowed from somebody's older sister.
tapes.story: For a campfire at Plage des Cèdres. Half the songs are unfinished bedroom demos.

tapes.label: ~~FÊTE A KEVIN~~ // RETOUR DE HULL
tapes.handwriting: The party title vigorously crossed out in thick purple felt marker.
tapes.story: Repurposed for the three-in-the-morning exhausted drive back across the bridge.

tapes.label: ROCK A MON PÈRE (TOUCHER SOUS PEINE DE MORT)
tapes.handwriting: Precise drafting hand, done with a ruler.
tapes.story: Your dad's prized seventies tape, stolen from the basement because the riffs are perfect for cruising.

tapes.label: SPEED RACER MIX // ALLUMETTIÈRES
tapes.handwriting: Slanted forward at forty-five degrees to simulate velocity.
tapes.story: High-BPM everything, designed specifically to tempt you past the speed traps on the new bypass.

tapes.label: LA CASSETTE QUI GUEULE
tapes.handwriting: Crude hurried pencil with grease thumbprints.
tapes.story: Recorded with the input level pinned in the red. Distorts through any speaker ever made.

tapes.label: CHILL OUT // SOIR D'ÉTÉ
tapes.handwriting: Soft green gel pen with wavy underline flourishes.
tapes.story: For idling at the marina breakwater watching the sun go down across the bay.

tapes.label: ~~MIX ÉTÉ 2003~~ SUMMER 2004 V.2
tapes.handwriting: Last year's title scratched out, the new year in fresh red marker.
tapes.story: Two minutes of last summer's forgotten pop still bleeds through at the end of side B.

tapes.label: DRUM & BASS // 128kbps
tapes.handwriting: Block capitals with the bitrate proudly noted in the margin.
tapes.story: Downloaded file by file over four days, including two mislabelled tracks that turned out to be polka.

tapes.label: BATTLE OF THE BANDS - DEMO BRUT
tapes.handwriting: Raw black marker on a cracked shell held together with Scotch tape.
tapes.story: A four-track recording of your buddy's band practising in a basement on rue Principale.

tapes.label: POUR CONDUIRE LA NUIT SUR LA 148
tapes.handwriting: Sparse spaced-out capitals in black ink.
tapes.story: Hypnotic repetitive riffs that match the rhythm of the dashed lines on the rural highway to Quyon.

tapes.label: HOCKEY WARMUP
tapes.handwriting: Energetic sports lettering with a hockey stick drawn on the spine.
tapes.story: An old tournament warmup tape that still goes on when you need adrenaline before a street race.

tapes.label: EMO TEARS // JUILL. 04
tapes.handwriting: Tiny lowercase cursive with a broken heart doodle in the corner.
tapes.story: Recorded during a devastating two-day breakup that was completely resolved by Tuesday.

tapes.label: CASSETTE DE SECOURS // GLOVE BOX
tapes.handwriting: Utilitarian ballpoint on a yellowed label peeling at both corners.
tapes.story: Lives permanently under the tire gauge and the owner's manual, for when the radio has nothing but ads.

tapes.label: THE REAL DEAL // NO SKIPS
tapes.handwriting: Confident clean marker from someone with genuinely good handwriting.
tapes.story: Timed so precisely that side A ends with three seconds to spare before the auto-reverse clunks.

tapes.label: FÊTE AU CHALET
tapes.handwriting: Hurried blue ink with a beer bottle ring stain on the back of the sleeve.
tapes.story: Surviving artifact of a weekend at Lac des Loups that somehow ended up in the door pocket.

tapes.label: CALME-TOI LES NERFS
tapes.handwriting: Gentle flowing script with a drawn peace sign.
tapes.story: Given to you by your mother after she watched you leave the driveway too fast. Pan flute and ocean waves, end to end.

tapes.label: ~~RAP FRANÇAIS~~ // ROCK ALTERNATIF
tapes.handwriting: The top half of the label physically torn off and replaced with masking tape.
tapes.story: Recorded over an album your cousin brought back from France because nobody liked the beats.

tapes.label: TOP SECRET // N'ÉCOUTE PAS ZAHRA
tapes.handwriting: Bold dramatic block letters in red Sharpie.
tapes.story: Sayyad's private collection of cheesy eighties pop that he only plays alone in the Civic.

tapes.label: CRUISING AYLMER-HULL 2004
tapes.handwriting: Standard blue Bic with '2004' underlined several times.
tapes.story: The definitive soundtrack of going up and down Chemin d'Aylmer with the windows down.

tapes.label: SOLO GUITARE // TROP FORT
tapes.handwriting: Chaotic oversized capitals covering the whole front of the J-card.
tapes.story: Nothing but extended live guitar solos clipped out of rock albums.

tapes.label: DÉPART POUR LE CÉGEP // 28-08-2004
tapes.handwriting: Sober neat black gel pen with the date small in the corner.
tapes.story: A farewell tape from a friend moving into a student residence in Montreal at the end of the month.

tapes.label: LE SON DU TRUCK // VOLUME 1
tapes.handwriting: Industrial block letters in orange highlighter outlined in black.
tapes.story: Tuned specifically to compensate for the Ranger's rattling exhaust.

tapes.label: CASSETTE SANS NOM // BONNE CHANCE
tapes.handwriting: A single giant question mark in blue ballpoint. No other text.
tapes.story: Found under the passenger seat with no case. Nobody remembers whose it was until you press play.

tapes.label: ÉTÉ 2004 // LE DERNIER MIX
tapes.handwriting: Faded black pen on the back of a folded receipt stuffed into the case.
tapes.story: Assembled in the final week of August. Every track carries the same ending.
